targets.query:
from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wildlife_camera" and r._field == "image" and r._value == 1)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.camera, set: ["hc960-01", "hc960-02", "hc960-03", "hc960-04", "hc960-05"]))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["camera"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "images")

targets.query:
import "date"

from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1y), stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "elg_felling" and r.jaktfelt_id == "1840J0096" and r._field == "felling")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Fellinger i historikken

panels.description: Kumulativt antall fellinger i inneværende kalenderår.

targets.query:
import "date"

from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1y), stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "elg_felling" and r.jaktfelt_id == "1840J0096" and r._field == "felling")
  |> group(columns: ["jaktfelt_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])
  |> yield(name: "Felt")

panels.title: Fellinger gjennom årets jakt

panels.description: Historisk fordeling etter Statskogs detaljerte Kategoriskutt-felt.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: 2019-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "elg_felling" and r.jaktfelt_id == "1840J0096" and contains(value: r._field, set: ["felling", "kategori_skutt"]))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "storvilt_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["kategori_skutt"])
  |> sum(column: "felling")
  |> rename(columns: {felling: "_value"})
  |> keep(columns: ["kategori_skutt", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> yield(name: "Fordeling")

panels.title: Fordeling

panels.description: Historisk antall fellinger gruppert per kalenderår.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: 2019-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "elg_felling" and r.jaktfelt_id == "1840J0096" and r._field == "felling")
  |> group(columns: ["jaktfelt_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> yield(name: "Felte elg")
